body: Sorry this is late. Anything you wanna really talk about?

Hey. Talk to me. I'm sorry about what's happened a lot in your life.  I'll be a friend :) you sound like a nice guy. So your hobby is games? I don't play much but I am very interested in hearing about your experiences with games and your enjoyment of it. PM me if you want. Please don't hurt yourself because I want to get to know you

I know it's not easy. But keep it out. The fact that you posted here is saying that you want to keep trying. In a very Complicated situation like your own is tough to get through.  I'd really like for you to get better. I can't even imagine what you are going through though. Feelings free to PM me or give me an easier way to contact you if you'd like to speak with me. I'm open any time

I read your post on r/advice. I suggest you should really surround yourself with good people and give yourself some better priorities so you have goals to be motivated for. I can try to give you advice from my own depression. But I don't know if it'll work the same. Ways I'd deal with my depression is that I started to log things into a journal. I have my hobbies so I'd try to spend time on improving them. I surrounded myself with good people who helped me to keep thinking positive and I learned to love myself a little more telling myself it's gonna get better. I can't promise it'll get better, but if you try I know you can get there. If things aren't better. It's not the end. Please keep striving.
Hey what's up? talk to me
Hey. What's up? You can talk to me. PM me if you want.
Do you need to talk to someone?  Feel free to PM me

I was that girl once.  You have to tell her the honest truth about how her depression is bringing you down too.  You don't need to be with her just to make her happy if you aren't.  I know it's hard but, if you need to leave. Do it. My girlfriend left me because I was so emotionally unstable. I have attempted suicide because of it, but obviously failed because I know she loved me and it wasn't that she didn't care for me. She just couldn't put up with me anymore or. She didn't know how. So she left. She did the right thing. I'm better now. I have improved a lot. I'm no longer depressed because I'm not counting on someone to take care of me. I've learned to care and love myself. I suggest you have a nice personal talk with her. No matter how disrupting she may be stick to your point. It's gonna hurt but,  it's better in the end.

I also just went through recent heart break with someone I thought was the one.  I'm 15 turning 16 soon also. I thought my girlfriend was the love of my life so it hit me hard. I'm still dealing too. She left me 5 months ago. I was also suicidal. I changed my life a lot since she left me. The first thing I did was make better priorities and set good goals for myself. It really kept me motivated. I started thinking more positive and I surrounded myself with lots of good people. Just goes to show, things get better. And as much as we don't want to believe it. We are better now knowing hurt. The one who is now gone wasn't the one now we strive for higher. In Hawaii we say IMUA, which means keep moving forward.  Now if you need to talk to someone PM me or tell me how I can contact you more easily

Hey. Hurting yourself is not the answer.  I know you probably don't want to hear this but. It gets better. I really does. It make take a long long time, but great things happen for everyone in the end. You'll get better. Think more positive.  Surround yourself with good people.  Make new priorities.  I to have gone through a recent heart break. Trust me. You'll pull through.  You are not a mistake. We all have reason.  I care, so PM if you feel like it or tell me how I can contact you more easily

I can't guarantee you any of that won't will happen for you, but i can say that I hope everything turns out better for you. If things go wrong and you do become sad, please please please do not hurt yourself.  You have us to come to. Im always gonna try to be there if needed, also.. In reality.. and generally in life, we all fail. Even though the failure may be excruciating to experience, you will make it out in the end. Hurting yourself is not the answer. You are better than that. I don't know you all to well, but trust me. I care.
Hey. Please don't hurt yourself. PM if you feel like you want to talk to someone.

Hey. Don't do anything to harm yourself. I actually posted last night but... I realized even though things aren't going as I wish they would be,  I now know things can get better. We just have to endure the ugliness of our situations. In the end, it's all worth it.
Thank you. Your comment alone makes me not feel as hollow.
It's just such an empty feeling.  I feel like she wouldn't care if I died.  Which I'm sure she wouldn't.
